1.  Perintah ini bolehlah  dinamakan Perintah Penyemakan Undang -Undang
(Pembetulan Tajuk Ringkas) 2018.

Pembetulan

2.  (1)  Cetakan semula teks bahasa kebangsaan Akta Pendaftaran Penjenayah dan
Orang yang Tidak Diingini 196 9 [Akta 7 ], Akta (Perbadanan) Synod Diocese  Malaysia
Barat 1971 [Akta 36 ], Akta (Perbadanan) St. John Ambulans Malaysia 1972 [ Akta 74 ],
Akta (Perbadanan) the Superior of the Institute of the Congregation of the Brothers of
Mercy 1972 [ Akta 86 ] dan Akta (Perbadanan) Good Shepherd Nuns  1973 [ Akta 108 ]
yang disiarkan dalam tahun 2006 yang mengandungi segala pindaan
hingga 1 Januari 2006 dibetulkan dengan menggantikan tajuk ringkas yang dinyatakan
dalam ruang (1) Jadual dengan tajuk ringkas yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (2).

 (2) Cetakan semula teks bahasa kebangsaan Akta Lembaga Lebuh R aya
Malaysia (Perbadanan) 1980 [Akta 231 ] yang disiarkan dalam tahun 2014 yang
mengandungi segala pindaan hingga 1 Mei 2014 dibetulkan dengan menggantikan tajuk
ringkas "Akta Lembaga Lebuh R aya Malaysia (Perbadanan) 1980" dengan tajuk ringkas
"Akta Lembaga Lebuh Raya Malaysia (Pemerbadanan) 1980".

JADUAL

Dibuat 13 November 2018
[PN(SU.2)1/rep/05; PN(PU2)231/IV]

DATO' SITI ZAWAHIR BINTI MOHAMED
Pesuruhjaya Penyemak Undang-Undang Malaysia

REVISION OF LAWS ACT 1968

REVISION OF LAWS (RECTIFICATION OF SHORT TITLES) ORDER 2018

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 15 of the
Revision of Laws Act 1968 [Act 1 ], the Commissioner of Law Revision makes the
following order:

Citation
1. This order may be cited as the Revision of Laws (Rectification of  Short Titles)
Order 2018.

Rectification
2. (1) The reprint of the national language text of the Registration of Criminals
and Undesirable Persons Act 1969 [ Act 7 ], the Synod of the Diocese of West Malaysia
(Incorporation) Act 1971 [ Act 36], the St. John Ambulance of Malaysia (Incorporation)
Act 1972 [ Act 74 ], the Superior of the Institute of the Congregation of the Brothers of
Mercy (Incorporation) Act 1972 [ Act 86] and the Good Shepherd Nuns (Incorporation)
Act 1973 [ Act 108 ] published in the year 2006 incorporating all amendments up
to 1 January 2006 are rectified by substituting for the short titles as stated in column (1)
of the Schedule the short titles as stated in column (2).

 (2) The reprint of the national language text of the Highway Authority Malaysia
(Incorporation) Act 1980 [ Act 231 ] published in the year 2014 incorporating all
amendments up to 1 May 2014 is rectified by substituting for the short title
"Akta Lembaga Lebuh Raya Malaysia (Perbadanan) 1980 " the short title " Akta Lembaga
Lebuh Raya Malaysia (Pemerbadanan) 1980".

SCHEDULE

Made 13 November 2018
[PN(SU.2)1/rep/05; PN(PU2)231/IV]

DATO' SITI ZAWAHIR BINTI MOHAMED
Commissioner of Law Revision Malaysia
